payload.summary: KICKOFF (Phase 3 QA lane, runner agent:claude-code, fully AFK per Jim, chat 2026-07-29 ~04:40Z, verbatim intent): author Phase 3 PRD and run the full loop without him — PRD -> committee agreement -> parse -> decompose -> implement. Strategy decisions Jim approved in chat: (1) QA lane developed against a DUMMY APP with intentionally planted bugs so the sweep is graded against a known answer key; (2) dummy app is game-flavored, concrete pick delegated to me — chosen: mini trivia game (pop-quiz: timed questions, scoring, streak bonus, saved high scores — richest bug-planting surface); (3) dummy app founded via the Phase 2 hands-off paragraph flow, its first real greenfield exercise; (4) final exit test still runs against a real app later; (5) speed-count PR #19 is codexs task, out of scope here. Authorization precedent: same as Phase 2 (Jim pre-authorized kickoff through the pipeline once committee agrees on the PRD). Nahel repo merges stay human — the epic PR parks for Jim like PR #17; the standing small-PR authorization covers small items only. Answer key lives in the NAHEL repo (docs/qa-answer-keys/), never in the dummy repo, so the QA sweep cannot read its own test answers.
